name: com.aiskills402/mcp
title: AISkills402
description: Tested AI agent skill files (SKILL.md), bought once over x402 for cents on Base. Free MCP search.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the tested agent skill files for sale (free). Give a plain-language query (for example: sound less like ChatGPT), or filter by category, tag or language, or combine them. With a query the results come ranked by relevance; without one you get the featured skills first. Each card has match_reason (the field that matched, or the filter), price_usd (a one-time purchase of the SKILL.md file, yours forever), what it is for, what it is not for, and how it was tested. limit is at most 24.

query.description: Plain-language search text, for example 'sound less like ChatGPT'. At most 100 characters. Omit it to get the featured skills first instead of a ranked search.

category.description: Only skills in this category. One of: writing, editing, marketing, seo, research, code, agents, sales-support, business, data, translation, education (see list_categories). Any other value is an error.

tag.description: Only skills with this tag: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, at most 32 characters, for example 'humanize'.

language.description: Only skills that work in this language: a 2-3 letter code such as en, bg or de, or 'any'. Skills marked 'any' always match.

limit.description: How many skills to return, 1 to 24. Default 24.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the twelve skill categories (free) with a short introduction and how many skills are listed in each. Use a slug as the category filter of search_skills.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill card (free) plus the exact x402 payment_required body for its one-time purchase of the SKILL.md file, and how_to_buy. Price is price_usd on the card. Buying is over HTTP; MCP does not take payments.

slug.description: The skill's slug, as returned by search_skills (for example 'humanize'). An unknown or unlisted slug is an error.

tools.name: redownload_skill
tools.description: Re-download the SKILL.md file you already bought (free), using the token from your purchase receipt. Always returns the current version of the skill.

token.description: The re-download token from your purchase receipt (the 'redownload' part): 64 lowercase hex characters. Not your payment signature.
